items.label: USAO-MA civil: MD Spine Solutions LLC, d/b/a MD Labs Inc.
items.detail: False Claims Act settlement over billing federal health programs for medically unnecessary urine drug tests; date is the announcement date. Release says MD Labs and co-founders Grizelj and Rutledge (left out as individuals) together pay no less than $11.6 million and up to $16 million depending on MD Labs finances; entered the stated ceiling. Settlement agreement states they admit the billing facts. Cash-only rule applied 2026-10-11: amount changed from 16,000,000 to 11,600,000; the part not counted is listed in data/manual/excluded-amounts.csv as xa-018. | Not counted in the total. Shared total, split not stated by the source: counted for no company, kept in gross (overlap group shared-usao-ma-2021-md-labs; listed under Amounts not counted).

excluded_amounts.defendant: MD Spine Solutions LLC, d/b/a MD Labs Inc.
excluded_amounts.reason: Release: MD Labs and its two co-founders "will pay the government and various states no less than $11.6 million and up to $16 million, depending on MD Labs' financial circumstances over time." Counted: the $11.6 million floor. Not counted: the conditional $4.4 million. The co-founders' share is not split out. Update 2026-10-11 (shared total): the $11.6 million floor is itself one total paid by MD Labs together with its two co-founders, with no split stated (release: 'MD Labs, Grizelj, and Rutledge will pay the government and various states no less than $11.6 million'), so it is counted for no company (overlap group shared-usao-ma-2021-md-labs, data/manual/shared-allocations.csv).
